description: Two truths can exist at the same time #reality #LifeByDesign #individualism
transcript: One thing that is so important to me is the fact that two truths can exist at the same time in knowing that I Take things less personal. I am more willing to remove emotions and Welcome logic because I understand that the tally way is not the only way and that's okay The more that I focus on me and self-control I Lose the desire to need to control outcomes or control how others should respond or react I have to hold myself accountable. I have to relearn and reassess. I have to take care of me
